channel.title: InnotechInsider — Startups
channel.description: Funding, founders, and the companies trying to build the next big thing.

item.title: The Toxic Term Sheet Clauses VCs Are Sneaking Past Founders in 2026
item.description: Behind soaring AI valuations, venture capitalists are sliding predatory covenants into 2026 term sheets. Here is what to watch before signing away your equity.

item.title: The Musk Precedent: How Tesla's Pay War Reshaped Startup Governance
item.description: Tesla's historic battle over Elon Musk's compensation changed venture law forever. By late 2026, early-stage founders are rewriting the rules of board control.

item.title: Reinier Zonneveld’s GasLab Bags $1M to Bring Generative AI to the Stage
item.description: Techno maestro Reinier Zonneveld has secured $1M for GasLab, a startup engineering zero-latency neural synthesis to bring real-time AI to live stage performances.

item.title: Can 'EU Inc' Save European Tech, or Will Bureaucrats Kill It?
item.description: Europe's proposed 28th corporate regime aims to standardize cross-border incorporation and stock options. But national lobbying risks gutting the initiative.

item.title: Graham Martin Backs HomeTruth to Solve Real Estate’s Due Diligence Crisis
item.description: HomeTruth names serial entrepreneur Graham Martin Chairman after securing fresh capital, targeting real estate’s costly, opaque transaction failure problem.

item.title: Cori Clinical Bags $4M to Fix Medicine’s Billion-Dollar Protocol Trap
item.description: With an oversubscribed $4M seed round, Cori Clinical wants to simulate clinical trial protocols before costly amendments derail drug pipelines. Here is how.

item.title: Nscale Bags $3.36B Pre-IPO Round as the AI Megawatt War Escalates
item.description: Nscale secures $3.36B in pre-IPO equity and debt to expand its gigawatt-scale AI infrastructure, proving that raw grid capacity is now tech's most valued asset.

item.title: The AI Boom Promised Meritocracy. Women in Tech Got the Same Old Bias.
item.description: Despite trillion-dollar AI valuations, female founders captured barely 2% of VC capital in 2026. The technical revolution forgot to fix its oldest culture problem.

item.title: Cornelis Networks Nabs $205M to Crack Nvidia’s Networking Grip
item.description: Cornelis Networks has secured $205M to scale its open-standard fabrics, taking direct aim at Nvidia's high-margin InfiniBand monopoly in hyperscale AI clusters.

item.title: Why d-Matrix Is Bending the Knee to Nvidia’s Interconnect Moat
item.description: Inference startup d-Matrix will integrate Nvidia's NVLink interconnect into its AI server architecture, proving that in 2026, memory fabrics beat raw silicon.

item.title: Singapore Bets S$220M on Fintech Innovation as VC Funding Hits 10-Year Low
item.description: With private venture capital plunging to decade lows, Singapore is injecting S$220M into high-risk fintech. Here is how state capital aims to reshape the sector.

item.title: ZuriQ's $25.5M Bet Proves 2D Quantum Architectures Are Coming
item.description: Quantum computing faces a critical interconnect bottleneck. ZuriQ's $25.5M funding aims to solve physical qubit routing through a novel 2D planar array.

item.title: Europe’s Defense Tech Awake: Airbus Anchors a €500M Mega-Fund
item.description: Airbus is anchoring a massive €500M defense tech venture fund, signaling Europe's shift toward sovereign militaries. Its first deal highlights AI warfare.

item.title: UK AI Startup Humanoid Hits $1.35B Valuation in Series A
item.description: London-based robotics firm Humanoid raised $152 million in Series A funding at a $1.35 billion valuation. European physical AI is mounting a serious challenge.

item.title: The Glyph Health Scandal: Why a Diabetes Tech Pioneer Ousted Its Founder
item.description: Leaked emails and whistleblower documents reveal how a prominent diabetes startup silenced its chief medical officer to push unvalidated AI onto vulnerable patients.

item.title: Syntetica Bags $30M to Solve Fashion's Dirtiest Secret: Nylon
item.description: Syntetica's $30M Series A highlights a major shift in materials science. Can its low-energy depolymerization tech finally make synthetic textiles fully circular?

item.title: Why VCs Are Betting $175M on Kraken's Autonomous Ghost Ships
item.description: Kraken Autonomy just joined the unicorn club with a massive $175M funding round. While self-driving cars stall, the maritime AI revolution is officially setting sail.

item.title: Spiro Hits $1.4B Valuation on Fresh $320M NewTrails Round
item.description: Edge-inference startup Spiro secured $320 million in Series C capital led by NewTrails. The round pushes the robotics silicon designer into unicorn status.

item.title: AI Cost Shock: PointFive Grabs $60M to Tame Enterprise Spending
item.description: As enterprises grapple with ballooning AI infrastructure costs, PointFive just secured $60M to bring much-needed financial discipline to machine learning deployments. This massive funding round signals a critical shift towards optimizing every dollar spent on AI, moving beyond raw compute power to intelligent efficiency.

item.title: Florida’s Halcyon Nuclear Banks $140M to Put Thorium Back on the Grid
item.description: St. Petersburg-based Halcyon Nuclear secured fresh venture capital to commercialize molten-salt thorium reactors, bypassing critical bottlenecks in uranium supply.

item.title: NewOrbit's $18.5M Series A Propels VLEO: The Next Frontier in Space?
item.description: NewOrbit secures $18.5M in Series A funding, aiming to commercialize Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO) with novel propulsion tech. This investment signals growing confidence in a high-risk, high-reward orbital frontier set to revolutionize Earth observation and connectivity.

item.title: UK's £400M Chip Bet: Can It Keep Startups Scaling and Staying Home?
item.description: The UK government is banking on a £400M semiconductor strategy to keep its brightest tech startups from fleeing abroad. But is a targeted investment enough to tackle deep-seated challenges in scaling and retaining innovative businesses?

item.title: The Great AI Washout: Where Billions in Venture Capital Vanished
item.description: Venture cash flooded generative AI for three years, but 2026 is exacting its toll. As cloud credits expire, hundreds of well-funded startups face a quiet reckoning.

item.title: The New Startup Flex: Making Tens of Millions With Under Five Employees
item.description: Software startups in 2026 are flipping Silicon Valley's headcount obsession upside down, generating eight-figure revenues with teams that fit in a single booth.
